messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — prepping a QBR for VeloxHealth next Thu. Finance flagged an unusual burn pattern last month, want to align on token runway + a budget-trigger playbook. Sharing quick numbers below.

Ajay Patel: Can you paste the month-over-month token split? embeddings vs gen?

Maria Chen: Sure — rough: total tokens 12.6M, embeddings ~7.8M (62%), gen/completions ~4.8M (38%). Cost skewed by high-embedding batch jobs they started mid-month.

Jordan Lee: I pulled the per-route spend: embeddings bucket has 40% of calls but 70% of payload bytes. Looks like a daily bulk re-index at 02:00 UTC.

Kenji Sato: If it's a batch re-index, we can suggest shifting to smaller incremental runs + enable prefix caching on Redwood side. That should shave ~25% of token churn.

Elena Ortiz: I have an enablement session with VeloxHealth scheduled Wed 10am PT. I'll cover best practices but need a short slide + a one-pager on throttles and alerts. Anyone have a 1-slide cost explainer I can use? :pray:

Maria Chen: I'll draft a 1-pager. Key asks: (1) recommend incremental index (2) enable batching window + KV cache (3) set a budget-alert at 80% of committed run rate.

Ajay Patel: For forecasts, I ran a quick projection script — if they maintain current pattern, next 30d burn ≈ $6.2k (embeddings 4.1k, gen 2.1k). If we apply Kenji's 25% reduction on embeddings, projection drops to ~ $4.9k.

Kenji Sato: Command I used (feel free to reuse):
```
redwood forecast --account veloxhealth --window 30 --detailed
```
Outputs token/day and cost/day. We should attach this to the QBR packet.

Maria Chen: Good. Can someone set an automated budget alert to ping the account team and Velox billing contact at 75% and 90%? I want a test trigger before Wed.

BillingBot: @Maria Chen — budget alerts created for veloxhealth: thresholds 75%, 90%. Test alert will fire when we invoke the simulator. :robot_face:

Jordan Lee: I'm running a simulated spike test now (adds synthetic 200k embedding tokens). Will report whether both alerts fire and who gets notified.

Jordan Lee: Update: 75% test alert fired to #velox-ops and to billing@veloxhealth.com. 90% not fired (expected). Screenshots saved to the QBR folder. :white_check_mark:

Elena Ortiz: Thanks — I'll include the alert flow in the enablement deck. Also want a short script for them to opt into cost-saver mode (lower throughput + aggressive caching) for maintenance windows.

Maria Chen: Action items: 1) Kenji to write the incremental-index recommendation + example config (due EOD). 2) Ajay to attach the 30d forecast and delta with 25% embedding reduction. 3) Jordan to add screenshots + alert receipts to QBR folder. 4) Elena to finalize enablement slide + send invite. 5) I'll run a quick billing walkthrough on Wed with them.

Kenji Sato: Will post the example config here — quick preview:
```yaml
indexing:
  mode: incremental
  batch_size: 500
  window: 30m
  enable_prefix_cache: true
```

Ajay Patel: I'll upload the forecast CSV to the QBR folder and include a short note about expected savings and assumptions.

Maria Chen: One more ask — capture Velox feedback on whether embedding fidelity was impacted after they switched to quantized models last quarter. That could explain re-index behavior. Elena, can you add a feedback checkbox on the enablement call agenda?

Elena Ortiz: Yep — added. Also added a quick poll to the meeting invite: "Did you notice lower embedding recall since quantization?"

Maria Chen: Perfect. If no blockers, we'll wrap this thread. I'll circulate the final packet by Tue COB. :v:
